jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionSentra is the AI Data Readiness platform for enterprises deploying AI at scale.
jobs.description:
Description

Sentra is the AI Data Readiness platform for enterprises deploying AI at scale. Sentra continuously discovers, classifies, and governs sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, data warehouses, and AI environments - giving security teams complete visibility into what AI systems can access, what they can expose, and where compliance violations exist. Unlike alternatives that copy data to vendor clouds or require customer-managed outpost infrastructure, Sentra provisions ephemeral scanners directly inside the customer's environment, delivering petabyte-scale classification at a fraction of the cost. Trusted by Lyft, SoFi, Munich RE, PennyMac, Glovo and others.

jobs.companyName: The Medical College of Wisconsin, Inc.
jobs.description:
Summary

Performs basic-to-complex financial and business-related analyses to support departmental operating budgets and financial operations, provider productivity and benchmarking processes, business plans, forecasting models, and practice leadership. Ad hoc financial duties as assigned.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Performs financial analysis, analyzes P&L statements, and prepares accurate and timely reporting to enable decision-making by practice leadership
  • Provides financial support in the business development and assessment of potential new business opportunities
  • Identifies potential opportunities for improvement to internal financial/business processes
  • Assists management with analysis and implementation of financial/business process improvements

jobs.title: AI/ Supply Chain Intelligence Intern
jobs.excerpt: Standard Job Description Selected individual will be a member of the Lockheed Martin Supply Chain (LMSC) Internship Program, applying AI/ML techniques to enhance supply chain forecasting, optimization
jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

Selected individual will be a member of the Lockheed Martin Supply Chain (LMSC) Internship Program, applying AI/ML techniques to enhance supply chain forecasting, optimization, and automation. The candidate will gain exposure to how LM leverages advanced analytics to improve demand visibility, inventory management, and operational efficiency across the enterprise. Responsibilities may include assisting in the development or validation of ML models for predictive analytics, supporting data preprocessing and feature engineering for supply chain datasets, and helping evaluate model performance against operational key performance indicators. Learning objectives will cover fundamentals of supply chain AI/ML applications, data-driven decision support, and LM’s approach to responsible AI integration within operational workflows.
